note: Problem families and their occurrences, for tools/recurrence-report.mjs. One entry per family; `events` lists the date each member problem was found. A family with two events inside one quarter raises the alert its rule describes.

families.title: 上游语义假设未实测
families.rootCause: a parameter or flag was assumed to work the way a neighbouring command works, without running --help or a probe

events.detail: gh api given --json, a flag it does not have; 5 actions failed on every call
git flags passed to gh repo clone before the -- separator
release list and search repos/commits asked for field names those commands do not have
the whole query passed as one argv element; gh quotes each positional

families.title: 已知契约约束未转守卫
families.rootCause: the constraint was read in the official documentation but never became a machine check

events.detail: no peerDependencies declared, so the plugin failed to import entirely
sentinel resolution wrote into the frozen arguments object
job owner passed as an Agent object where a SessionId is required
background work started before the jobs.start preflight
resource registered without ctx.effect, so disposal leaked it
patch row used a bare subpath, which resolves from nowhere the launcher looks

families.title: 验证方法不镜像真实契约
families.rootCause: the test environment differed from the runtime contract, or the verifying tool itself was wrong

events.detail: 5 actions never executed successfully once; 97 offline checks were green throughout
a counting idiom returned zero on real matches, and a literal search treated | as text
the guidance guard validated an in-memory copy of the skill bodies rather than the files on disk, so the two could disagree unnoticed

probe-guidance passed 113/113 and verify exited 0 while the RUNNING composition served the previous generation of all three skill bodies: the catalog was won by a rank-250 runtime registration left over from the earlier design, which outranks the packaged provider at rank 600. Every guard tested PackSkillProvider in isolation and none consulted a real registry, so the composition was green and stale at the same time. Found by an independent audit, confirmed by invoking the skill tool, fixed by an app restart.

preventionWins.note: probe-guidance rejected three injected violations (directory/frontmatter mismatch, missing write boundary, missing description) that would otherwise have shipped silently
probe-branch-switch refused all 15 injection attempts including --force, -C and a newline-hidden second argument, on its first run

families.title: 新对外接口未对照宿主安全语义
families.rootCause: a new externally reachable surface was assumed to inherit the host's authentication

events.detail: the route answered 200 with the branch payload to a request that / rejects with 401

families.title: 构建与分发操作未隔离风险边界
families.rootCause: a build or distribution step was performed without accounting for what still depends on what it removes

events.detail: packing into the source directory emptied test/ and tools/
the previous tarball was deleted immediately after packing the new one; a subsequent EPERM left the profile depending on a file that no longer existed, and install_bundle could not repair it

preventionWins.note: check-profile.mjs caught a half-broken profile immediately after remove_bundle failed with EPERM, naming the missing bundle entry and the deleted tarball before a restart could drop the plugin

families.title: 文档与实现漂移
families.rootCause: a description promised a capability the implementation never had

events.detail: repo branches ignored its own branch parameter
three wrong conclusions drawn from a single source; 'not found' treated as 'does not exist'
github_search declared a `kind` enum that no action read; it looked like the tool's primary selector and did nothing
the probe's command label was a hand-written list of five layers and kept listing five after a sixth was added

preventionWins.note: the offline suite failed on three route-count assertions the moment the branch-switch routes were added, and one of them exposed a REAL source bug: the diagnostics route still reported routes: [BRANCH_ROUTE, DIAGNOSTICS_ROUTE] after the set grew to four. The guard caught the implementation drifting from what it published, in CI, before the release.

families.title: 位置假设被结构变化打破
families.rootCause: a reader addressed a collection by position, so appending an element silently changed what it read

events.detail: the probe reported its `repo` field from layers.at(-1); after a sixth layer was appended it reported the git route instead

families.title: 把已识别的不确定性当作已排除
families.rootCause: a limitation was named in the output and then not acted on, so a conclusion rested on evidence already known to be insufficient

events.detail: three reference plugins were analysed from their READMEs with a note that the code was unread, and those descriptions were then used to decide what to build; reading the code refuted three of the claims
